first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The light blue area above the horizon, lighter and brighter near the horizon.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: A large expanse of light yellowish-brown ground, with patches covered by low grass alternating with exposed ground and a rough surface texture.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Clumped tree and shrub crowns scattered across the middle and distant views, varying in shade and size.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A long, narrow light-brown road strip extending from the right side into the middle and distant views, with multiple approximately parallel linear tracks within it.

entities.name: Curved Ground Mark
entities.identification: Dark nested arcs and groove-like bands arranged in groups on the ground, interspersed with light-colored raised bands.

entities.name: Distant Long, Narrow Water Surface
entities.identification: The smooth, narrow blue-gray water strip in the distant view at the far right of the initial frame, adjoining a light-colored shoreline.
